title: CODATA 2022: the deuteron mass is 3.343 583 7768 × 10⁻²⁷ kg
summary: In u, 2.013 553 212 544. The energy equivalent is 1875.612 945 00 MeV.
body: The NIST 2022 listing prints 'deuteron mass 3.343 583 7768 e-27' kg, standard uncertainty '0.000 000 0010 e-27' kg. 'deuteron mass in u 2.013 553 212 544', standard uncertainty '0.000 000 000 015' u. 'deuteron mass energy equivalent in MeV 1875.612 945 00', standard uncertainty '0.000 000 58' MeV. The deuteron-proton mass ratio on the same listing is 1.999 007 501 2699 with standard uncertainty 0.000 000 000 0084.
